newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential raises 3M view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential raises 3M view.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities said it raised earnings estimates and repeated a buy recommendation for Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co after the company reported strong 1996 third quarter earnings above estimates.
- Prudential analysts raised their 1996 earnings estimate to $3.60 a share from $3.55, their 1997 estimate to $4.10 from $4.00 and their 1998 estimate to $4.60 from $4.50.
- 3M reported 1996 third quarter earnings rose to $0.95, compared with a First Call consensus estimate of $0.93.
- Shares of 3M were trading up 1-5/8 to 72-7/8.
